newsitem.title: USA: Wild shootout captured live on L.A. television.
newsitem.headline: Wild shootout captured live on L.A. television.

text.p: A wild movie-type shootout erupted on the streets of Hollywood on Friday after a botched bank robbery, with at least one robber shot by police, some arrested and several officers wounded.
The whole incident, with bursts of automatic weapons fire, was captured on videotape by news helicopters and shown live on local television stations.
In one graphic image, a robber was seen firing a handgun at police and then falling to the sidewalk after he was hit by police fire.
Another gunman was seen firing an automatic rifle through the windscreen of a car before surrendering to police in the residential neighbourhood.
Details were sketchy, but at least five gunmen were involved, dressed in black fatigues and ski masks.

They attempted to rob a bank in North Hollywood and then came out shooting. Police cordoned off the area, closing a nearby freeway, and were searching for any remaining gunmen who may be in the area on foot.
